info.title: v2.push.set_app_push_config
info.description: you can turn on or turn off your app push config setting through this open api

post.description: you can turn on or turn off your app push config setting through this open api

parameters.name: blocked_shop_id_list
parameters.description: Use this filed to set shops that need to be blocked.Please input no more than 500 shop id.

parameters.name: callback_url
parameters.description: The callback url of push mechanism. It is the address where the Shopee will send the push message to. If you don't set any callback_url before, this parameters is required.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: set_push_config_off
parameters.description: Turn off Push config, Shopee won't send the push message into the callback url. 1=Shop authorization for partners 2=Shop deauthorization for partners 3=Order status update push 4=TrackingNo push 5=Shopee Updates 6=Banned item push 7=item promotion push 8=reserved stock change push 9=promotionn update push 10=webchat push 11=video upload push 12=openapi authorization expiry push 13=brand register result

parameters.name: set_push_config_on
parameters.description: Turn on push config, Shopee will send the push message into the callback url. 1=Shop authorization for partners 2=Shop deauthorization for partners 3=Order status update push 4=TrackingNo push 5=Shopee Updates 6=Banned item push 7=item promotion push 8=reserved stock change push 9=promotionn update push 10=webchat push 11=video upload push 12=openapi authorization expiry push 13=brand register result

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.uat.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/push/set_app_push_config?partner_id=partner_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => '{
    "blocked_shop_id_list": [
        10010,
        20020,
        30030
    ],
    "callback_url": "https://open.shopee.com/",
    "set_push_config_off": [
        6,
        7,
        11,
        12,
        13
    ],
    "set_push_config_on": [
        1,
        2,
        3,
        4,
        5,
        8,
        9,
        10
    ]
}',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

import requests
import json

url = "https://partner.uat.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/push/set_app_push_config?partner_id=partner_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp"

payload=json.dumps({
  "blocked_shop_id_list": [
    10010,
    20020,
    30030
  ],
  "callback_url": "https://open.shopee.com/",
  "set_push_config_off": [
    6,
    7,
    11,
    12,
    13
  ],
  "set_push_config_on": [
    1,
    2,
    3,
    4,
    5,
    8,
    9,
    10
  ]
})
headers = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}
response = requests.request("POST",url,headers=headers, data=payload, allow_redirects=False)

print(response.text)
